title: When to Intervene? An Empirical Study of Errors and Self-Recovery in LLM Agents
why: Studies when computer-use and web agents self-recover after errors versus needing human intervention; ReCoF predicts recovery.
mechanism: Evaluation/feedback for computer-use and Web agents: ReInBench traces of errors and self-recovery; ReCoF predicts whether an error will self-recover to decide intervention vs wait
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: ReInBench has 1,259 agent traces and 1,403 error events across computer-use and Web tasks; 725 errors self-recover; ReCoF +9.02% relative Macro-F1 vs strongest baseline — not independently verified.
evidence_locator: arXiv abs abstract (v1); project page method-notes.github.io/ReCoF (anonymous.4open code + HF ReInBench dataset links)

title: Right Click, Wrong Box: Grading GUI Grounding by What a Click Does
why: Replaces box-only ScreenSpot scoring with outcome-equivalent clicks on live web UIs for GUI grounding evaluation.
mechanism: Evaluation for GUI grounding: execution probe + outcome maps / execution judge so a click is correct if it yields the same outcome as the annotated target on live web apps
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: three 7–8B grounders on a code forge and online shop; ~1/5 and ~1/3 of box-rejected clicks still reach the intended outcome; GRPO with equivalent-click reward no stable gain over box rewards across 3 seeds and 4 test sets; probe/maps/audit released — not independently verified.
retrieval_notes: Wed cs.CV /new. Abs opened. No github in abs. Full PDF not read. Not in corpus/inbox.

title: AdaGround: Token-Normalized Adaptive Zooming with Verifier-in-the-Loop Refinement for GUI Grounding
why: Training-free adaptive zoom plus click verifier for high-res GUI grounding on ScreenSpot-Pro and OSWorld-G.
mechanism: Perception/grounding for GUI agents: token-normalized adaptive zoom from predicted target size; verifier-in-the-loop Yes/No keep/reject/re-ground/abstain; compositional spreadsheet cell grounding from headers
evaluation_signal: Author-reported on Qwen3-VL: +7.4 to +20.6 points over backbone on OSWorld-G and ScreenSpot-Pro; gains carry to held-out UI-Vision — not independently verified.
evidence_locator: arXiv abs abstract (v1); official code repo README stub

title: GUI-JEPA: Candidate-Conditioned JEPA Latents as a Fast Action Policy for Mobile GUI Agents
why: Decoder-free JEPA latent policy scores mobile GUI action candidates in one pass without token decoding.
mechanism: Architecture/action policy for mobile GUI agents: JEPA encoder on unlabelled screenshots; action/region-conditioned latent predictor; lightweight heads score candidates vs instruction in one batched pass without autoregressive decoding
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: vs Qwen2.5-VL-7B agent fine-tuned with same inputs, reaches 86–92% of in-distribution accuracy with 6% of its parameters — not independently verified.
evidence_locator: arXiv abs abstract (v1); official code repo
retrieval_notes: Wed cs.AI /new. Abs opened; github.com/bcwang-sjtu/GUI-JEPA confirmed (created 2026-10-26). Full PDF not read. Not in corpus/inbox.

title: Learning to Look Beyond Screens: Transferable Visual Observation from GUI Grounding
why: Trains multi-turn crop-and-inspect observation on GUI grounding trajectories so perception transfers beyond interfaces.
mechanism: Perception for GUI agents as scalable spatial supervision: SFT on teacher GUI grounding trajectories then RL for multi-turn crop-and-inspect; aims to transfer observation strategies beyond GUI imitation
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: LBS on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Qwen3.8-27B improves over baselines; gains beyond SFT transfer to PerceptionBench (both) and HR-Bench/ChartQAPro (35B) — not independently verified.
evidence_locator: arXiv abs abstract (v1); code branch UI-Venus/tree/LBS; HF inclusionAI/LBS-27B

title: From Interaction to Capability: Task Advancement as State and Supervision for GUI Agents
why: Task Advancement Memory stores verified cross-app GUI progress and learns reusable operations from successful steps.
mechanism: Memory/supervision for GUI agents: Task Advancement State tracks verified progress across apps; post-task advancement supervision abstracts interactions that produced verified local results into reusable operations with inputs/outcomes/verification
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: +success over strongest evaluated baseline and −38.7% lifecycle tokens per solved task; SPA-Bench SOTA single-app English Level 3 — not independently verified.
